title: Threshold Energy (a)
description: Essential Criteria: The correct threshold gamma-ray energy of 144.7 MeV must be calculated for part (a).

title: Minimum Proton Energy (b)
description: Essential Criteria: The minimum proton energy of 6.787 x 10^10 GeV must be correctly determined for part (b).

title: Correct Use of Invariants
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply the invariant mass equation in both parts (a) and (b).

title: Energy Conservation
description: Important Criteria: The student should demonstrate understanding of energy conservation principles in the context of the reaction.

title: Implications Discussion (c)
description: Optional Criteria: A brief speculation on the implications for cosmic-ray protons should be provided in part (c).

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common sign errors in the energy-momentum equations.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.
